title: Communicate an unambiguous meeting time
prompt:
Meeting is 2026-10-15 at 14:00 UTC. For this fixture New York is UTC-04:00 and London is UTC+01:00 on that date. Convert both local times and retain timezone labels.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. date: YYYY-MM-DD; new_york_time, london_time: HH:MM; new_york_offset, london_offset: signed HH:MM.
remediation_hints: Convert times using the supplied date-specific offsets, not ambiguous local shorthand.
